yue2_3b.summary: Top-tier open-source song quality; vocals and backing in one pass
yue2_3b.description: Highest open-source score on WildSongBench (self-reported; comparable to Suno v5). Chinese and English lyrics; leave the lyrics empty for an instrumental. Q4 quantisation uses about 10 GB of memory; song length follows the lyrics.
yue2_3b.promptHint: English tags work best, comma-separated: language, genre, instruments, vocals.

ace_step_1_5_turbo.summary: Fastest; MIT-licensed for commercial use; 50+ lyric languages
ace_step_1_5_turbo.description: Planner + diffusion hybrid that renders a song in 8 steps. Trained on licensed, royalty-free and synthetic music, so output is commercially usable. Full BF16 build (quantising breaks the planner's sampling), about 10 GB on disk.
ace_step_1_5_turbo.promptHint: Describe style, mood, instruments and vocals in natural language, in English or Chinese.

minimax_music_3.summary: Top open model in third-party blind tests; full songs up to 5 minutes
minimax_music_3.description: The only open model on the Artificial Analysis vocal leaderboard (Elo 1000). 8B global LLM + 0.6B local LLM + flow matching, 32 kHz stereo. Lyrics are required; best for fully structured pop songs.
minimax_music_3.promptHint: Write a detailed music description: genre, BPM, key, emotional arc, vocals and arrangement.
minimax_music_3.licenseNote: The model name must be shown in your product UI; written authorisation is needed above USD 20M annual revenue; public content must be labelled as AI-generated

stable_audio_3_medium.summary: Best instrumental quality; a whole BGM track in seconds
stable_audio_3_medium.description: 2nd on the CMU Music Arena instrumental board (behind Lyria 3 Pro). Instrumentals only, no lyrics. Ideal for scores, BGM and ambient music; prompts must be in English.
stable_audio_3_medium.promptHint: Describe genre, instruments, mood and BPM in English, e.g. cinematic, 90 BPM.
stable_audio_3_medium.licenseNote: Free for commercial use below USD 1M annual revenue; see the official licence

stable_audio_3_small.summary: Lightest at 1.7 GB; quick demos and loops
stable_audio_3_small.description: The small Stable Audio 3 music model: runs in about 4 GB of memory and is very fast, with lower quality than Medium. Instrumentals only; prompts must be in English.
stable_audio_3_small.promptHint: Describe genre, instruments, mood and BPM in English.
stable_audio_3_small.licenseNote: Free for commercial use below USD 1M annual revenue; see the official licence
